about: Live web updates (LiveWeb.java): where each site's signed web bundle manifest is, and the Ed25519 public keys (hex) its signature must match. No key, no live updates: the release pipeline's private key exists only in Infisical, and a key is added here only on the owner's word (production key pinned 29 Oct 2026 on the owner's order). app.salesxray.in is the same production web app on the customer domain and pins the same key (salesxray.in, 2 Nov 2026); the app reads only the entry for the site it starts on, and a manifest signed for another host is refused. A test build's CI may replace this file (src/debug/assets/live-web.json, never committed).
